dataset.name: Vehicle Insurance Claim Fraud Detection
dataset.license: CC0-1.0 (reported in the cited dataset research paper)

stopReason: Workers AI account limits (HTTP 429: throttling, then the Workers Free daily allocation of 10,000 neurons)

truncation.reason: From claim 1,347 onward every failure was a fast HTTP 429 account-limit rejection (25–100 ms, before inference), confirmed by direct probes. Rows from that claim on were dropped so account limits are not counted as model errors. Earlier errors (two 8 s timeouts, one invalid LLM response) are genuine and kept.
